# LayoutAlign

Where a [Layout](Layout.md)'s children sit along an axis when they leave space
over.

## Values

- `start`: Against the start: the left or the top.
- `center`: Centered.
- `end`: Against the end: the right or the bottom.
- `space-between`: Along the main axis, spread out with the space left shared between the children; across it, the same as `start`.
